description: Answers one open research question from the live web in at most 80 words with up to 3 source URLs, returned as {answer, sources}, usually in 4 to 9 seconds. Use it for a synthesized answer; use web.search for raw links or research.factcheck to verify a claim. Name the people, places and dates the question depends on, and ask one question per call: several in one call get one blended answer. Read-only. Paid per call with x402, up to 60 calls a minute per client; a call that fails, times out or hits capacity is not charged. For several questions, make one call per question: calls are independent and can run in parallel.

q.description: The research question to answer, 1 to 500 characters.

answer.description: Short answer synthesized from the live web.

sources.description: Source URLs the answer rests on.
